caption: The drawing depicts a relief-style arrangement of various objects rendered in grayscale, giving a stone-like appearance. On the left section, there is a vertical rectangular slab with a raised cross attached to its surface. In front of this slab, and slightly to the right, is a vase containing tall, elongated plants or stalks with multiple stems fanning outward. Directly above the vase is the torso of a headless and armless statue, positioned with minimal detail where the neck and shoulders would be. On the right side of the composition, there is an object resembling a crown or an ornate, cylindrical headpiece with a textured pattern. Below this, there is a rectangular block divided into two squares, which may represent books or boxes. At the top left margin above the cross, there are two stacked, rectangular objects, possibly closed books or containers. The overall composition is compact, with each object overlapping or touching the others, and the entire scene is drawn against a plain, light background. The artist's signature, "Ursula Lauderdale," appears near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Limestone Font
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
